summary: Eight canonical risk dimensions keep roof evidence, public equity, policy, spatial, cost, and operation boundaries visible. Every roof is closed in the current evidence state; the complete design can still operate at grade.

dimensions.label: 数据隐私与AI活动安全
dimensions.note: Public AI tests and event records could expose participants, systems, or personal information.
dimensions.mitigation: Use synthetic data, consent, minimization, human review, isolation, and an offline route.
dimensions.human_review: Security, privacy, accessibility, and community reviewers

dimensions.label: 公平与包容
dimensions.note: A roof-first event could exclude users or make public service dependent on weather and vertical transport.
dimensions.mitigation: Require same-program, same-information, same-booking-rights ground fallback before any roof decision.
dimensions.human_review: Disabled people, older adults, carers, residents, and event operators

dimensions.label: 实施复杂度
dimensions.note: Real-building inventory, structure, fire, accessibility, waterproofing/drainage, and emergency evidence must align for one candidate.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep all roofs closed until qualified reviews share an exact building, use, scope, date, and expiry.
dimensions.human_review: Architect, structural and fire professionals, accessibility users, waterproofing specialist, emergency teams

dimensions.label: 运维成本
dimensions.note: Inspection, repair, drainage cleaning, security, accessibility, insurance, and closure staffing create long-term cost.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep cost unknown; require life-cycle budget, funding owner, maintenance duty, and stop rule.
dimensions.human_review: Quantity surveyor, owner, operator, insurer, finance and maintenance teams

dimensions.label: 政策与责任不确定性
dimensions.note: Title, lease, co-owner consent, planning, filing, public access, insurance, and operator liability may conflict.
dimensions.mitigation: Do not announce a real site or date until consent, applicable process, and named duty are documented.
dimensions.human_review: Owner, tenants, residents, legal counsel, insurer, operator, and relevant authorities

dimensions.label: 公众接受与状态误读
dimensions.note: A closure light, roof rendering, or heritage label could be mistaken for danger, certification, approval, or historical fact.
dimensions.mitigation: Explain zero as evidence not passed, keep ground service first-class, and co-review language with communities.
dimensions.human_review: Residents, disabled and older users, heritage specialists, communication and event teams

dimensions.label: 空间争议
dimensions.note: The site and key areas are rough repository constraints, unsuitable for exact siting, title, heritage, or statutory claims.
dimensions.mitigation: Regenerate every spatial and presentation artifact after official polygons and surveyed conditions arrive.
dimensions.human_review: Organizer data team, survey/planning, title, heritage, and community reviewers

dimensions.label: 技术与证据成熟度
dimensions.note: A synthetic five-gate ledger proves decision logic only; it cannot prove a real roof, system reliability, or qualified review.
dimensions.mitigation: Version evidence, verify signatures and scope, rehearse expiry/closure/fallback, and require independent professional review.
dimensions.human_review: Independent professional reviewers, owner/operator, data governance and audit teams
